notes.title: Changelog August 8th Build 1.0.240808
notes.notes:
[h3]Changelog August 8th Build 1.0.240808[/h3]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45000651/5f7584216d3cb962ea51aaf82ffe2b2d5c458037.png[/img]
- The main character's default name, "Alex," can now be customized, allowing users to select their preferred name.
- Fixed a bug in the bakery minigame that caused it to skip directly to the scoring part.
- The minigame has been made easier by reducing the time required and increasing income by 200%.
- Resolved an issue in the quest system where players could not enter the school and home at the same time.
- The name of the main character is now changeable, with "Alex" as the default option.
